summary_markdown: The conversation addressed two main points regarding data filters. First, a feature was confirmed as released the previous day. Second, there was a discussion about filtering facilities that contain the text 'stock' in their name within the `select facility` filter. The original issue concerned whether these specific facilities were excluded from the filter results. It was determined that while such a filter exists, it is currently case-sensitive. [me] offered to make this filter case-insensitive, which [unknown] requested.
decisions: The 'select facility' filter will be made case-insensitive for names containing 'stock'.
action_items: [me] to implement the case-insensitive filtering logic.
